title: Case 27: The West Mesa Bone Collector

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The eastern side of the city of Albuquerque, New Mexico, is closed in by mountains.
sentences.zh: 新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基市的东侧被群山环绕。

sentences.en: On the city's west side, a mesa rises out of the Rio Grande Valley.
sentences.zh: 在城市的西侧，一座平顶山从格兰德河谷拔地而起。

sentences.en: In 2005, subdivisions and new housing were being built along the West Mesa.
sentences.zh: 2005年，西平顶山沿线正在进行住宅小区和新房建设。

sentences.en: The construction pressed up against a vast desert that stretches beyond, where you will find tumbleweeds, high-tension wires, and trash.
sentences.zh: 建筑工地紧邻着一片广袤的荒漠，那里随处可见风滚草、高压电线和垃圾。

sentences.en: It is a desolate, isolated spot.
sentences.zh: 那是一个荒凉、孤立的地方。

sentences.en: In 2008, the economy crashed, and the new homes stopped being built.
sentences.zh: 2008年，经济崩溃，新房建设随之停工。

sentences.en: It was on a 92-acre lot of land, on the West Mesa, one year later, 2009.
sentences.zh: 一年后的2009年，在西平顶山上一块92英亩的土地上。

sentences.en: Where subdivision work had started, but construction had never gone ahead.
sentences.zh: 那里曾启动过住宅开发项目，但施工从未真正推进。

sentences.en: Where a serial killer's burial ground was found.
sentences.zh: 在那里，人们发现了一处连环杀手的埋尸地。

sentences.en: Detective Ida Lopez, from the Albuquerque Police Department, was assigned to the missing persons unit in 2005.
sentences.zh: 阿尔伯克基警察局的侦探艾达·洛佩兹于2005年被分配到失踪人口调查组。

sentences.en: She was the only detective assigned there.
sentences.zh: 她是该组唯一的侦探。

sentences.en: It was low-priority work.
sentences.zh: 这是一项优先级很低的工作。

sentences.en: Detective Lopez was the first officer to sense something wasn't right in Albuquerque.
sentences.zh: 洛佩兹侦探是第一位察觉到阿尔伯克基有些不对劲的警官。

sentences.en: Two missing persons reports came across her desk.
sentences.zh: 两份失踪人口报告送到了她的办公桌上。

sentences.en: Both women fit a similar profile.
sentences.zh: 这两名女性的特征非常相似。

sentences.en: They were known sex workers, who also used drugs.
sentences.zh: 她们都是已知的性工作者，且有吸毒史。

sentences.en: And they vanished without a trace.
sentences.zh: 她们就这样消失得无影无踪。

sentences.en: Not letting friends or family know of their whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 没有告知亲友她们的去向。

sentences.en: It's common in these types of cases for family members to hear,
sentences.zh: 在这类案件中，家属经常会听到这样的说法：

sentences.en: Well, that's just part of the lifestyle they live.
sentences.zh: “好吧，这就是她们生活方式的一部分。”

sentences.en: Sometimes people don't want to be found.
sentences.zh: 有时人们就是不想被找到。

sentences.en: They don't have to keep contact with you, or tell you where they are.
sentences.zh: 她们没必要和你保持联系，也没必要告诉你她们在哪里。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean they're missing.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着她们失踪了。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what many families of the victims in this case heard.
sentences.zh: 而这正是本案中许多受害者家属所听到的回应。

sentences.en: But Detective Lopez couldn't ignore the similarities in these two missing girls' appearance, or the circumstances in which they vanished.
sentences.zh: 但洛佩兹侦探无法忽视这两名失踪女孩在外貌特征以及失踪环境上的相似之处。

sentences.en: She started looking into other cases involving women who had disappeared from Albuquerque that matched the same profile.
sentences.zh: 她开始调查其他涉及阿尔伯克基女性失踪的案件，寻找符合相同特征的案例。

sentences.en: She discovered more and more cases that all bore eerie similarities.
sentences.zh: 她发现了越来越多有着惊人相似之处的案件。

sentences.en: The list of missing women eventually grew to 24.
sentences.zh: 失踪女性名单最终增加到了24人。

sentences.en: Some were crossed off that list as time went on, eventually turning up either back in Albuquerque or in other parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，其中一些人被从名单上划掉，最终在阿尔伯克基或其他地区被找到。

sentences.en: But it was clear something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，事情有些不对劲。

sentences.en: The common thing the missing girls shared was that they were involved in sex work, and many battled drug addiction.
sentences.zh: 这些失踪女孩的共同点在于她们都从事性工作，且许多人深受毒瘾困扰。

sentences.en: The area of Albuquerque all of the victims were known to work is referred to by some as the war zone.
sentences.zh: 阿尔伯克基所有受害者已知的活动区域，被一些人称为“战区”。

sentences.en: In recent years, the area was rebranded as the International District.
sentences.zh: 近年来，该地区被重新命名为“国际区”。

sentences.en: There is an area there on Central Avenue that is something of a red light district.
sentences.zh: 中央大道上有一片区域，某种程度上算是红灯区。

sentences.en: It's a place where the most vulnerable, the most desperate, show up, looking for money, looking for drugs.
sentences.zh: 那里是社会最脆弱、最绝望的人出现的地方，她们为了钱和毒品而来。

sentences.en: It's also where people prey on those who have no place else to turn.
sentences.zh: 这也是那些无处可去的人被猎食的地方。

sentences.en: Detective Lopez hit the streets to try and find out as much information as she could, questioning anyone who would speak to her about the missing girls,
sentences.zh: 洛佩兹侦探走上街头，试图尽可能多地收集信息，询问任何愿意与她谈论这些失踪女孩的人，

sentences.en: trying to find out about their last movements, if they knew each other, trying to find that common thread.
sentences.zh: 试图了解她们最后的行踪，确认她们是否相识，并寻找那条共同的线索。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before Detective Lopez started to hear about the rumours circulating the streets at the time.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，洛佩兹侦探就开始听到当时在街头流传的传言。

sentences.en: There were whispers around town that Albuquerque had its own version of Jack the Ripper, a psycho preying on vulnerable victims who he felt society wasn't going to miss.
sentences.zh: 城里有传言说，阿尔伯克基有了自己的“开膛手杰克”，一个专门猎杀脆弱受害者的变态，他认为社会不会想念这些人。

sentences.en: The rumours even mentioned specifically the missing girls were dead and were buried on the West Mesa.
sentences.zh: 传言甚至具体提到，那些失踪的女孩已经遇害，并被埋在西平顶山上。

sentences.en: As that information was just rumour at the time, there was no evidence to go on, no specific spot to start.
sentences.zh: 由于当时这些信息只是传言，没有证据支持，也没有具体的地点可以作为起点。

sentences.en: The West Mesa was too vast of an area to start searching for victims who might be buried there.
sentences.zh: 西平顶山的范围太大了，无法开始搜寻可能被埋在那里的受害者。

sentences.en: It's the desert.
sentences.zh: 那是荒漠。

sentences.en: Where would the police even begin?
sentences.zh: 警方又能从哪里开始呢？

sentences.en: They needed something more.
sentences.zh: 他们需要更多的线索。

sentences.en: And so Detective Lopez kept working, kept pounding the pavement, asking questions, trying to find out what happened.
sentences.zh: 于是，洛佩兹侦探继续工作，奔波于街头，四处询问，试图查明真相。

sentences.en: Part of the investigation process carried out by Detective Lopez was asking for dental records and taking DNA samples from family members of the missing girls.
sentences.zh: 洛佩兹侦探调查过程的一部分，是要求提供牙科记录，并采集失踪女孩家属的DNA样本。

sentences.en: This work would prove vital later on.
sentences.zh: 这项工作后来被证明至关重要。

sentences.en: As the years passed though, nothing much came of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 然而随着岁月流逝，调查并没有取得太大进展。

sentences.en: There was very little media coverage of the missing girls.
sentences.zh: 媒体对这些失踪女孩的报道非常少。

sentences.en: Not many people seemed to care.
sentences.zh: 似乎没多少人关心。

sentences.en: It was never really in the public's minds.
sentences.zh: 这从未真正进入公众的视野。

sentences.en: There are varying reports depending on where and who you are getting them from, about just how hard the police were actually looking.
sentences.zh: 关于警方到底有多努力地进行搜寻，根据消息来源的不同，说法也各不相同。

sentences.en: Most of the local media didn't even bat an eyelid at the story, even turning some of the victims' families away, refusing to give it any airtime.
sentences.zh: 大多数当地媒体甚至对这个故事视而不见，甚至拒绝了一些受害者家属的求助，拒绝提供任何曝光机会。

sentences.en: If there was any truth to that rumour about Albuquerque having its own Jack the Ripper, it looked like he was proven right.
sentences.zh: 如果关于阿尔伯克基有“开膛手杰克”的传言有任何真实成分，那么看起来他确实说对了。

sentences.en: Society didn't seem to care.
sentences.zh: 社会似乎并不关心。

sentences.en: The story didn't really fade from the public's mind, because it was never really there in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这个故事并没有从公众心中淡去，因为它从一开始就从未存在过。

sentences.en: Nobody other than the families of the missing girls and Detective Lopez seemed to care.
sentences.zh: 除了失踪女孩的家属和洛佩兹侦探，似乎没人关心。

sentences.en: It was the 2nd of February 2009, five years after Detective Lopez had made up a liSt.
sentences.zh: 那是2009年2月2日，距离洛佩兹侦探整理出名单已经过去了五年。

sentences.en: And Christine Ross, who lived in one of the new housing subdivisions on the West Mesa, was taking her dog for a walk.
sentences.zh: 住在西平顶山新住宅区之一的克里斯汀·罗斯正在遛狗。

sentences.en: Her dog started playing with a bone sticking out of the ground on an abandoned construction site that was supposed to have had new homes built on it by now.
sentences.zh: 她的狗开始玩弄一根从废弃工地上露出来的骨头，那片工地本应早已盖好了新房。

sentences.en: Christine felt uneasy about the bone.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀对这根骨头感到不安。

sentences.en: It didn't look like any of the usual animal bones she had found in the area before.
sentences.zh: 它看起来不像她以前在该地区发现的任何常见动物骨头。

sentences.en: She took a picture of it and sent it to her sister, who was a registered nurse.
sentences.zh: 她拍了张照片发给身为注册护士的姐姐。

sentences.en: Her sister got back to her almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 她姐姐几乎立刻就回复了她。

sentences.en: It looked like a human femur.
sentences.zh: 那看起来像是一根人类股骨。

sentences.en: Christine contacted the Albuquerque Police Department.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀联系了阿尔伯克基警察局。

sentences.en: They arrived and were able to quickly determine that it was most definitely a human bone.
sentences.zh: 他们赶到现场，很快确定那绝对是人类骨骼。

sentences.en: A crime scene was established.
sentences.zh: 警方随即封锁了现场。

sentences.en: It would become the largest crime scene in Albuquerque history.
sentences.zh: 这成为了阿尔伯克基历史上最大的犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Human bones were found scattered in one section of a 92-acre piece of land owned by a home developer, KB Home.
sentences.zh: 在房地产开发商KB Home拥有的一块92英亩土地的某个区域，发现了散落的人类骨骼。

sentences.en: It was the work that KB Home had already completed on the site that made the huge task more complicated.
sentences.zh: KB Home已经在该地块完成的施工，使得这项巨大的任务变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: The builders had done extensive grading and digging and a lot of heavy machinery had been used in order to get the land ready to build on.
sentences.zh: 建筑商进行了大规模的平整和挖掘，为了准备建设用地，使用了大量重型机械。

sentences.en: That work had totally changed the landscape and shattered many of the bones in the process,
sentences.zh: 这些工作彻底改变了地貌，并在过程中震碎了许多骨头，

sentences.en: scattering their location.
sentences.zh: 导致它们的位置四散。

sentences.en: The police had to call in state-of-the-art equipment to help process the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 警方不得不调集最先进的设备来协助处理犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Ground-penetrating radar, lasers, aerial photography and digital mapping were all used.
sentences.zh: 探地雷达、激光、航空摄影和数字测绘都被用上了。

sentences.en: In total, police dug through 40,000 cubic yards of dirt, digging down as far as 15 feet in some places.
sentences.zh: 警方总共挖掘了4万立方码的泥土，在某些地方挖掘深度达15英尺。

sentences.en: It took them two and a half months of processing the crime scene before they were satisfied that they had recovered all of the victims buried at the site.
sentences.zh: 他们花了两个半月的时间处理犯罪现场，才确信已经找回了所有埋在该处的受害者。

sentences.en: In total, there were 11 female victiMs.
sentences.zh: 总共有11名女性受害者。

sentences.en: The youngest was 15.
sentences.zh: 最年轻的只有15岁。

sentences.en: The oldest was 32.
sentences.zh: 最年长的为32岁。

sentences.en: One of the victims was also four months pregnant.
sentences.zh: 其中一名受害者当时还怀有四个月的身孕。

sentences.en: Reconstructing the skeletons was a long and difficult process.
sentences.zh: 重建骨骼是一个漫长而困难的过程。

sentences.en: It was like putting together a giant puzzle.
sentences.zh: 就像拼凑一个巨大的拼图。

sentences.en: And a lot of the puzzle pieces were broken.
sentences.zh: 而且很多拼图碎片都已经碎了。

sentences.en: It would take one year before all of the victims were positively identified.
sentences.zh: 直到一年后，所有受害者的身份才得到最终确认。

sentences.en: The work of Detective Lopez in compiling the list of missing girls from Albuquerque and obtaining dental records and getting their DNA on file was a huge help to the investigation.
sentences.zh: 洛佩兹侦探整理阿尔伯克基失踪女孩名单、获取牙科记录并建立DNA档案的工作，对调查提供了巨大的帮助。

sentences.en: In total, seven of the 11 victims found buried at the West Mesa already appeared on that missing list compiled by Detective Lopez.
sentences.zh: 在西平顶山埋尸地发现的11名受害者中，总共有7人出现在洛佩兹侦探整理的失踪名单上。

sentences.en: Some of the victims have more information released about them than others.
sentences.zh: 关于其中一些受害者的信息比其他人披露得更多。

sentences.en: But those seven were.
sentences.zh: 但那七个人分别是：

sentences.en: Monica Candelaria, who was 21 years old.
sentences.zh: 莫妮卡·坎德拉里亚，21岁。

sentences.en: Monica enjoyed laughing, joking, looking after babies and spending time with her family.
sentences.zh: 莫妮卡喜欢欢笑、开玩笑、照顾婴儿以及与家人共度时光。

sentences.en: She was a loving mother to her son.
sentences.zh: 她是一位疼爱儿子的母亲。

sentences.en: She was last seen in South West Albuquerque on the 11th of May, 2003.
sentences.zh: 她最后一次露面是在2003年5月11日的阿尔伯克基西南部。

sentences.en: Monica was reported missing soon after her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 莫妮卡失踪后不久就被报了案。

sentences.en: Her report was treated primarily as a missing persons case, but it was noted that foul play could be involved.
sentences.zh: 她的报告主要被当作失踪人口案件处理，但记录显示可能涉及刑事犯罪。

sentences.en: Incredibly, detectives working the case heard a rumour that she had been killed and buried on the Mesa.
sentences.zh: 令人难以置信的是，负责此案的侦探听到传言说她已被杀害并埋在平顶山上。

sentences.en: That rumour would be proven right quite many years later, but nothing ever came of it at the time.
sentences.zh: 那个传言在多年后被证实是正确的，但在当时却没有任何下文。

sentences.en: The foul was turned over to the cold case unit after a few months.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，该案被移交给了悬案组。

sentences.en: That's where Detective Lopez discovered that the circumstances matched other missing girls in the area and she added Monica to her liSt.
sentences.zh: 在那里，洛佩兹侦探发现其情况与该地区其他失踪女孩相符，并将莫妮卡加入了她的名单。

sentences.en: Doreen Marquez, who was 27 years old.
sentences.zh: 多琳·马尔克斯，27岁。

sentences.en: She loved jewellery and fashionable clothes.
sentences.zh: 她热爱珠宝和时髦的衣服。

sentences.en: Always had her hair done and nails painted.
sentences.zh: 总是把头发梳理得整整齐齐，指甲也涂得漂漂亮亮。

sentences.en: She was a loving mother who was known to throw extravagant birthday parties for her children.
sentences.zh: 她是一位慈爱的母亲，以给孩子们举办奢华的生日派对而闻名。

sentences.en: In the year 2000,
Doreen's life started to unravel.
sentences.zh: 多琳的生活开始分崩离析。

sentences.en: She went through a difficult breakup and turned to heroin to numb the pain.
sentences.zh: 她经历了一次痛苦的分手，并开始通过吸食海洛因来麻痹痛苦。

sentences.en: By 2003, Doreen's behaviour had gotten very erratic.
sentences.zh: 到2003年，多琳的行为变得非常反常。

sentences.en: She would disappear for months at a time, leaving her children with their father or with family members.
sentences.zh: 她会一连消失好几个月，把孩子留给他们的父亲或家人照顾。

sentences.en: Her sister says she didn't live that lifestyle until the last few years of her life.
sentences.zh: 她的姐姐说，直到生命最后几年，她才过上那种生活。

sentences.en: That's when things started to unravel for Doreen and her addiction got the better of her.
sentences.zh: 那时多琳的生活开始失控，毒瘾战胜了她。

sentences.en: There are conflicting reports of when she was last seen.
sentences.zh: 关于她最后一次露面的时间，说法不一。

sentences.en: The police say it was October 2003, although a friend is adamant that she saw her after that.
sentences.zh: 警方称是2003年10月，尽管一位朋友坚称在那之后还见过她。

sentences.en: Whichever it was, she was reported missing in 2004.
sentences.zh: 无论哪种说法正确，她都在2004年被报失踪。

sentences.en: Victoria Chavez, who was 26 years old.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚·查韦斯，26岁。

sentences.en: She was reported missing by her mother in March 2005.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲于2005年3月报案称其失踪。

sentences.en: By that stage, she hadn't been seen or heard from in over a year.
sentences.zh: 当时，她已经一年多没有音讯了。

sentences.en: Veronica Romero was 27 years old.
sentences.zh: 维罗妮卡·罗梅罗，27岁。

sentences.en: She had four children and was reported missing in February 2004, not long after she was last seen.
sentences.zh: 她有四个孩子，在2004年2月被报失踪，距离她最后一次露面没过多久。

sentences.en: Cinnamon Elks was 32 years old.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙·埃尔克斯，32岁。

sentences.en: She was friends with three of the other victiMs.
sentences.zh: 她是其他三名受害者的朋友。

sentences.en: Victoria Chavez,
sentences.zh: 维多利亚·查韦斯，

sentences.en: Julie Nieto,
sentences.zh: 朱莉·涅托，

sentences.en: and Michelle Valdez, who you will hear about next.
sentences.zh: 以及你接下来会听到的米歇尔·瓦尔迪兹。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: “案件档案”稍后回来。

sentences.en: When Cinnamon's mother didn't hear from her for her birthday in August 2004, she knew something was wrong straight away.
sentences.zh: 当辛纳蒙的母亲在2004年8月她生日时没有收到她的消息，她立刻意识到出事了。

sentences.en: She reported her missing, although it took a few calls before that report was taken.
sentences.zh: 她报了警，尽管打了好几个电话才让警方受理这份报告。

sentences.en: She was told initially that Cinnamon was an adult and she had the right to cut contact with her.
sentences.zh: 起初她被告知，辛纳蒙是成年人，有权切断与她的联系。

sentences.en: Julie Nieto was 23 years old.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·涅托，23岁。

sentences.en: Enjoyed sewing, cooking, and music.
sentences.zh: 喜欢缝纫、烹饪和音乐。

sentences.en: A beautiful and devoted daughter, a loving mother, and a beloved friend.
sentences.zh: 一位美丽而孝顺的女儿，一位慈爱的母亲，以及一位深受欢迎的朋友。

sentences.en: Julie was a sweet girl who unfortunately fell to a drug addiction at age 19.
sentences.zh: 朱莉是个甜美的女孩，不幸的是，她在19岁时染上了毒瘾。

sentences.en: Her mother tried to get a treatment, but it didn't work.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲试图让她接受治疗，但没有成功。

sentences.en: Julie had a son who she doted over.
sentences.zh: 朱莉有一个她非常疼爱的儿子。

sentences.en: She was a loving mother.
sentences.zh: 她是一位慈爱的母亲。

sentences.en: Her family knew something was very wrong when she stopped sending birthday, Christmas, and Easter presents to her young son.
sentences.zh: 当她不再给年幼的儿子寄生日、圣诞节和复活节礼物时，她的家人就知道出大事了。

sentences.en: She was last seen in August 2004.
sentences.zh: 她最后一次露面是在2004年8月。

sentences.en: Michelle Valdez was 22 years old.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·瓦尔迪兹，22岁。

sentences.en: She had one daughter who she was devoted to.
sentences.zh: 她有一个深爱的女儿。

sentences.en: A good, kind-hearted person who would give you the shirt off her back if you needed it.
sentences.zh: 她是个善良的好人，如果你需要，她甚至愿意把自己的衬衫脱下来给你。

sentences.en: Fun-loving, always had a smile on her face and could brighten up the room with her personality.
sentences.zh: 她热爱生活，脸上总是挂着笑容，她的个性总能让整个房间充满活力。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, she fell into drugs and started disappearing for days at a time, then weeks, then months.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，她染上了毒瘾，开始一次消失几天，后来变成几周，甚至几个月。

sentences.en: She would return to visit her father and he would give her small sums of money, knowing it was likely going to be spent on drugs, but he gave it anyway in the hopes
sentences.zh: 她会回来探望父亲，父亲会给她一小笔钱，尽管他知道这很可能被拿去买毒品，但他还是给了，因为他希望

sentences.en: she would keep coming back.
sentences.zh: 她能继续回来。

sentences.en: One day, she never returned.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她再也没有回来。

sentences.en: She was reported missing in February 2005.
sentences.zh: 她于2005年2月被报失踪。

sentences.en: Michelle was four months pregnant at the time of her death.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔在去世时已经怀孕四个月了。

sentences.en: They were cousins and were both last seen together at a family gathering in 2004.
sentences.zh: 她们是表姐妹，最后一次被人同时看到是在2004年的一次家庭聚会上。

sentences.en: They left the family gathering and they were never seen again.
sentences.zh: 她们离开了聚会，之后就再也没有人见过她们。

sentences.en: Jamie was an outgoing

sentences.en: 15-year-old school student who loved to sing and dance, read and play sport.

sentences.en: Her smile was so bright it was enough to lift up anyone, no matter how down they were.
sentences.zh: 她的笑容非常灿烂，足以鼓舞任何人，无论他们当时有多沮丧。

sentences.en: Her older cousin,

sentences.en: Jamie and Evelyn were treated as runaways by police.
sentences.zh: 杰米和伊芙琳被警方视为离家出走者。

sentences.en: Their family members saying little was done in the way of an investigation.
sentences.zh: 她们的家人表示，警方在调查方面几乎毫无作为。

sentences.en: In fact, after the initial report, their family says they hardly heard from the police again.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在最初的报案之后，家人说他们几乎再也没有收到过警方的消息。

sentences.en: Selania Edwards was 15 years old.
sentences.zh: 塞拉尼亚·爱德华兹当时15岁。

sentences.en: She stands apart from the other victims as she was the only one with no known friends or family in Albuquerque.
sentences.zh: 她与其他受害者不同，因为她是唯一一个在阿尔伯克基没有已知朋友或家人的受害者。

sentences.en: Selania never knew her father and last saw her mother when she was five.
sentences.zh: 塞拉尼亚从未见过她的父亲，最后一次见到母亲是在她五岁时。

sentences.en: She ran away from foster care in Oklahoma in 2003, which is when she was reported missing.
sentences.zh: 她于2003年从俄克拉荷马州的寄养家庭逃走，当时她被报失踪。

sentences.en: She was last seen in the Denver area in May 2004.
sentences.zh: 她最后一次露面是在2004年5月的丹佛地区。

sentences.en: Police believe Selania may have been travelling along the I-40 interstate highway, which is how she ended up in Albuquerque.
sentences.zh: 警方认为塞拉尼亚可能沿着40号州际公路旅行，这也就是她最终来到阿尔伯克基的原因。

sentences.en: Virginia Cloven, who was 23 years old.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚·克洛文，当时23岁。

sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚是个风趣幽默的女孩，凡事都能泰然处之。

sentences.en: The type of person that if she told you a lie, two minutes later she would admit it and tell the truth because she felt bad.
sentences.zh: 她是那种如果你对她撒了谎，两分钟后她就会因为感到内疚而承认并说出真相的人。

sentences.en: When Virginia was 17 and still in high school, her brother was shot dead.
sentences.zh: 当弗吉尼亚17岁还在上高中时，她的哥哥被枪杀了。

sentences.en: Absolutely devastated and struggling to cope,
sentences.zh: 她彻底崩溃了，难以承受打击，

sentences.en: Virginia ran away from home.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚离家出走了。

sentences.en: She lived with her grandfather in Albuquerque for a little while before moving out with a boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 她在阿尔伯克基和祖父住了一段时间，后来搬出去和男朋友同居。

sentences.en: Tragically, her boyfriend got hit by a car and went into a coma.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，她的男朋友被车撞倒并陷入了昏迷。

sentences.en: Virginia lost the place they were living in and was soon homeless, living on the streets of Albuquerque.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚失去了住处，很快就流落街头，在阿尔伯克基的街头流浪。

sentences.en: Her parents last heard from her in June 2004.
sentences.zh: 她的父母最后一次收到她的消息是在2004年6月。

sentences.en: Virginia was never heard from again.
